title: Hosting settings and response headers are not in the repository
description: The site is a static GitHub Pages site (CNAME present). HTTPS enforcement, custom-domain verification and response headers are set in the hosting account, not in source, and no CSP meta tag is present in any page.
claimed_root_cause: Missing or lax hosting settings could allow downgrade or a hijacked custom domain; absence of CSP is not itself a demonstrated boundary violation.

trace.description: Custom domain served by hosting outside source control

evidence.description: Custom domain declared; Pages settings not visible in source.
Only per-page hardening found is a referrer meta tag; no CSP meta tags anywhere.

blockers: Repository Pages settings (enforce HTTPS, verified domain) are not visible in source
Response headers cannot be observed without probing the deployed site, which the audit rules forbid

validation_plan.deployment: Owner checks repo Settings > Pages: Enforce HTTPS on, domain verified. Optionally put Cloudflare in front to add CSP and security headers.

title: mailto link built from form input on the Kita support page
description: kita-bewerbung-tracker/support.html builds a mailto: URL from subject, email and message fields.
claimed_root_cause: Form input could inject extra mail headers (cc/bcc) or script.

trace.description: window.location.href set to the mailto URL

evidence.description: Recipient is a constant; subject and body go through encodeURIComponent, so CRLF and & cannot add headers.

reason: The visitor only affects their own mail draft, which they must send themselves. No other principal is affected.

title: Query parameters injected into custom-scheme redirect on auth page
description: pullupmaster/auth.html reads token_hash and type from the query string and builds a pullupmaster:// URL that it assigns to window.location.
claimed_root_cause: Attacker-controlled query values could alter the redirect target or inject script.

trace.description: Both values pass through encodeURIComponent into a fixed pullupmaster://login prefix
window.location.href set to the fixed-scheme URL

evidence.description: Scheme and host are constant; values are percent-encoded so they cannot add parameters or change the scheme.
no-referrer meta limits token leakage; replaceState at line 124 removes the token from the address bar.

reason: No boundary crossed: the redirect target is fixed, values are encoded, nothing is written to the DOM as HTML, and the page makes no third-party requests.

title: Secrets or private keys committed in the working tree or git history
description: Scanned all 107 commits and the working tree for API key, private key, token and credential patterns, and for env, key, keystore and p8/p12 file names.
claimed_root_cause: A credential was committed and is retrievable from the public repo.

trace.description: Only publisher-ID line; public by design for ads.txt

evidence.description: AdMob publisher ID is intended to be public; it is not a credential.

reason: No pattern matches in tree or history; no sensitive file names ever committed. Matches for the words password and token are privacy-policy prose.
